test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A 280 m long train travelling at a speed of 72 km/hr crosses a platform in 30 seconds. Find the length (in m) of the platform.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of train = 280 m

Speed of train = 72 km/hr = 72 × 1000 / 3600 = 20 m/s

Time taken to cross the platform = 30 seconds

**Formula used:**

Total distance = (Length of train + Length of platform)

Total distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Total distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Total distance = 20 × 30 = 600 m

Total distance = Length of train + Length of platform

⇒ 600 = 280 + Length of platform

⇒ Length of platform = 600 - 280

⇒ Length of platform = 320 m

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
